purpose: Create a five-second local identity-control preview between frontal and three-quarter portrait anchors.

referenceRoles.first-frame: Frontal or near-frontal identity anchor, pre-uploaded to ComfyUI input storage.
referenceRoles.last-frame: Same-person three-quarter endpoint, pre-uploaded to ComfyUI input storage.
referenceRoles.holdout-evaluation: A third angle used only by the quality gate and never by sampling.

exposedSlots.name: prompt
exposedSlots.constraints: Describe one continuous identity-preserving action; no scene cuts.

exposedSlots.name: firstFrameComfyName
exposedSlots.constraints: Filename returned by the local ComfyUI upload API.

exposedSlots.name: lastFrameComfyName
exposedSlots.constraints: Filename returned by the local ComfyUI upload API.

estimatedRuntime.note: Cold start includes loading the 32B text encoder and dynamic model staging.

validationChecks: duration is one valid H3 124-frame block
H.264 video and AAC stereo audio are present
one face remains present with stable age, hair, brows, nose, jaw and skin tone
no cut, duplicate face, obvious face morph or frozen interval
last-frame pose is reached without losing the first-frame identity
holdout angle is reviewed before promotion to production-approved
knownFailureSignatures: vertical references are center-cropped and may exclude clothing details
large background or focal-length mismatch between endpoint images can cause environmental morphing
this FL2VA Profile consumes two endpoint images; true three-or-more-image conditioning requires the separate H3 REF2VA weights
four-step Turbo favors speed over maximum facial micro-detail
safeRetryPatches: change seed once while preserving every other control
replace the last frame with a closer crop or smaller yaw delta
tighten prompt identity constraints without changing graph topology

lastValidation.observations: Identity, hairstyle, brows, eye spacing, nose and jaw remained visually stable from frontal to three-quarter view. The independent full-profile image remained recognizably consistent, but full-profile motion was not generated in this sample.
